title: Primitive local Boolean–Möbius repair coordinates: quotient, support sum, binary suffix, and signed repair

concepts.label: scaled Mersenne weight
concepts.note: The dyadically scaled reciprocal-Mersenne contribution at one rank.

concepts.label: finite-support quotient aggregate
concepts.note: The sum of integral quotient coordinates over a finite support.

concepts.label: natural binary suffix
concepts.note: The natural-subtraction remainder below a dyadic target.

concepts.label: signed local repair
concepts.note: The affine integer coordinate obtained from the preceding suffix and endpoint divisor count.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: localMersenneQuotient M d is the natural-number floor quotient 2^M/(2^d-1).
statement_nodes.engine: integral part of a scaled reciprocal-Mersenne weight
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project coordinate definition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: It is only the integral quotient part and does not equal the full scaled weight without the separate fractional remainder.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: localPrefixQuotient D M is the sum over d in D of localMersenneQuotient M d.
statement_nodes.engine: finite aggregation of the single-rank quotient coordinates
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project coordinate definition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The aggregate omits fractional mass and proves neither an exact half-target row nor a capacity inequality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: localBinarySuffix D k M is 2^(M-k)-localPrefixQuotient D M-1 using natural-number subtraction.
statement_nodes.engine: natural subtraction from the dyadic half-target coordinate
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project coordinate definition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Natural subtraction may truncate; the definition proves no honest signed residual, nonnegativity, or Boolean-word capacity.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: localRepairInteger D k n is 2*localBinarySuffix D k (n-1)+1-endpointDivisorContribution D n in the integers.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project coordinate definition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The value may be negative. The definition proves no nonnegativity, Boolean representation, upper-half capacity, exact row, or tempered-orbit identification.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The prefix quotient is definitionally the finite sum of the single-rank quotient coordinates.
The suffix subtracts the aggregated prefix quotient and the terminal unit from the depth-(M-k) dyadic target.
The signed repair coordinate doubles the preceding suffix, adds the affine unit, and subtracts the new endpoint divisor count.
